avis.titre: A very thorough, but gentle cleanser. Made in the USA!
avis.texte: This is an excellent, unscented gel cleanser that will thoroughly cleanse your skin without stripping it of needed moisture. I personally have combination skin, with an oily T-zone but dry cheeks, so I need something that will remove excess oil but not dry out my skin. This cleanser certainly does all of that. The gel pumps very easily from the dispenser and is thick enough to stay put but still thin enough to mix quickly with water to form a very light and thin lather. At first, I thought I didn’t use enough of the cleanser, since the lather was so light. But I proceeded to rub it all over my face and see how things went. I was surprised how cleanly it rinsed off and how much oil it removed. My face was clean, and just borderline streaky. After patting my skin dry, I was astonished that the oil was gone but my face didn’t feel taught due to a lack of moisture. This gel cleanser respected the moisture balance! This is probably due to the use of very gentle surfactants, such as coco-betain. I also noted that there was no sodium lauryl sulfate (SDS), for those who find sulfates irritating (and there’s some evidence that they are). SDS is a very aggressive detergent, and I would know since I’m a biochemist and we use it in the lab to denature proteins. It’s also fragrance free, which isn’t a selling point for me since I don’t mind a pleasant scent, but I know some people do. Once selling point for me is the fact Curology is made in the USA. The extreme cold this winter season has been harsh on my skin, so I wanted to try this Curology cleanser for its hydrating ingredients. It lathers up nicely and works well in cleansing my face. I love that it doesn't leave any residue. I’m not a fan of its scent, but it’s very faint and does not bother my sensitive nose. Sadly, I don't find this cleanser particularly hydrating on my dry, winter skin. It does feel soothing, but not hydrating. It feels like a pretty basic foaming cleanser. I will be using this in the milder months. The packaging for this cleanser is not suitable for shipping. I received mine with the safety seal broken and the cap broken off from the pump. Luckily, I was able to push the cap in enough to dispense the product. It would be nice if Curology provided a box for their product considering that their pump can't seem to handle shipping stress with Amazon's inappropriate packaging. With all things considered, I find that this cleanser is just ok. It is nice, but not as hydrating and softening as claimed. The packaging is not ideal and delivered a broken product. I feel that it's not worth the price with these issues.

avis.titre: Works well, but causes my skin to flush :(
avis.texte: [ITEM]: Curology Hydro+ Gel Cleanser [SIZE]: 150ML/4FL.OZ I want to love this. It works well, even on waterproof mascara. But, about a third of the time I use it, my face flushes deep red and purple. It doesn’t hurt or sting. If I didn’t see myself in a mirror, I wouldn’t know it was happening. But, it lasts about an hour, and I think I’m better off just throwing in the towel. You may want to look over the ingredients as well, in case you have any skin sensitivities: [INGREDIENTS]: Water, Glycerin, Potassium Cocoyl Glycinate, Coco-Betaine, Propanediol, Potassium Cocoate, Hyaluronic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Polyglutamic Acid, Caprylhydroxamic Acid, 1,2-Hexanediol, Squalane, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Coco-Glucoside Glyceryl Oleate, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Sodium Hydroxide, Sodium PCA, Sodium Phytate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Citric Acid, Pentylene Glycol
